𦰋.hint: Depicts a person (人) with their eye and eyebrows (𥄕) emphasized. 𥄕 also represents the sound. Original form of 瞢.

components.hint: Depicts an eye (目) with an eyebrow.

𦰩.hint: Depicts a tortured person or a criminal (黑) sighing (口). Original form of 嘆.

components.hint: Depicts a tortured person or a criminal.
